snippet.title: WHAT'S LEFT OF RAVE ROUGH
snippet.description:
GAME LINK: https://lua-computa.itch.io/rave-rough-demo 

Yeah, Rave Rough got cancelled like months ago lol. Why? It's just that... the game is very boring conceptually. Like woowwww a quirky platformer with a cartoon style? How original! It's hard working on a pretty basic game when literally most of your other projects are like WAYYY more interesting conceptually and stylistically. Also Rave Rough was a big ass project I began right after finishing a big ass project, Outer Outage, when all I really wanted to do after was make smaller stuff for a bit. I went through a whole year and a half of development pretty strong, but now... ughhh...

I had thought I had already stated this on Youtube, as I did on all of my other socials a few weeks ago but uh... nope. Apologies is if this is how you found out and were excited for this thing's release.

Anywho it's now it's the 2 year anniversary of Rave Rough! To celebrate I've put together a build containing all of the levels that had been completed layout-wise, along with a few extra levels and an extra score-attack mode I was prototyping too. I've also picked out a couple of old private builds of the game to include on the itch page as public downloads. Enjoy lol, just beware a lot of glitchy-ness :]
